title: Native API defect baseline
summary: As of 2026-10-23 trunk r13284 fixed global-reference (#2100), UNINIT (#2102), stack discovery (#2106), SysStemSort (#2120), but a native method invalid-arguments stale activation remained. Unpatched forced-GC repro crashed 3/3; local patch survived 3/3 and reported CheckCondition=1. Potential relevance to BSF is mechanistic, not confirmed crash attribution. SourceForge bug #2116 was filed by Tom Dyer on 2026-10-15 and remained open when checked 2026-10-27. Independently open #2104 and #2123 add nested context trap and non-SYNTAX propagation risks.
invariants: Do not claim upstream merge without verifying newer commits.
Never let a failed native signature leave an activation frame to be scanned by GC.
CheckCondition must be immediately observable and SYNTAX 88.922 propagated correctly.
Separate four upstream repairs from the outstanding native argument defect.
Do not file a duplicate of SourceForge #2116; it already includes the possible BSF4ooRexx850 core-dump relationship.
Treat #2104 and #2123 as distinct negative callback qualification gates, currently NOT_RUN.
